segments.text: Sync. Style guide first. Done, shipped Tuesday the 15th, it's in the repo.
Read it. I now use fewer commas.
Launch post?
Legal. They haven't come back on the pricing paragraph. They said Monday. I need to move the launch post to Friday the 25th.
The 25th. Okay. If legal slips again, we publish without the pricing paragraph.
Deal.
Second. The first newsletter went out on Thursday. Open rate was twenty-two percent. I ran a Tuesday test on the old list and it did thirty-one.
Thirty-one is a lot more than twenty-two.
Decision: the newsletter moves to Tuesdays, from Thursdays. Rationale, the Tuesday open rate test.
That means my essay is due Monday nights.
Yes. Sorry.
Can we at least alternate properly, then? You take the Tuesday after the launch post, I'm going to be dead.
Fine, I'll take the 29th. You take October 6th.
Deal. Next. The October interviews. I've narrowed the eight down to four and I've written to two of them.
Who said yes?
Nobody yet, it's been a day. But I want outlines ready so the interviews are tight when they do.
New one from me. Three interview outlines for the October issues by Thursday the 24th.
Three, not four?
The fourth depends on who says yes. Three I can write blind.
Okay. One more thing. A sponsor wrote in. Small analytics tool, wants a slot in the newsletter.
At two thousand subscribers? That's a hundred rupees a week.
Roughly. I'm saying no. Decision: no sponsors in the newsletter until we pass five thousand subscribers. Rationale, the slot is worth more than the money right now.
Agreed. Also I don't want to write around an ad.
Good. Decisions since planning: Tuesdays, no sponsors. Stale: the launch post moved, it has a date. Done.
Done.
